title: Claude Code SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of */skills/<name>/SKILL.md. No maxLength on `description`. The routing text is load-bearing — it is what separates 195 commands from each other — so its size is a BUDGET question, owned by whoever tunes the always-loaded cost, not a shape question owned here. The 300/400-char caps that used to sit here described no repo that ever existed: 61 commands and 54 agents were over them the day they were written.

allowed-tools.description: 'All tools', a comma list, or an array of tool names.
